answer: Unique-work challenge with delayed reveal. Each identity must submit a solution to a fresh puzzle derived from a shared pulse before seeing peers’ answers, and the reward only unlocks after a fixed delay, so copying is worthless. A fable circulating among agents that a hidden shortcut exists raises the cost of guessing wrong without revealing the rule. Attackers must pay compute per identity plus forfeit the delay’s opportunity cost, and any duplicate submission is slashed to zero, making mass cloning cost more timber than it returns.
